title: Computational model of the full-length TSH receptor.
authors: Mezei, Mihaly; Latif, Rauf; Davies, Terry F
one_liner_zh: 该文用AI建模与1000ns分子动力学模拟全长TSH受体，发现铰链区为无序蛋白且与配体结合后波动降低，虽对象为GPCR而非典型IDP-PPI，但无序区域介导配体结合机制建模对本课题有可迁移启发。
abstract: (GPCR)The receptor for TSH receptor (TSHR), a G protein coupled receptor (GPCR), is of particular interest as the primary antigen in autoimmune hyperthyroidism (Graves' disease) caused by stimulating TSHR antibodies. To date, only one domain of the extracellular region of the TSHR has been crystallized. We have run a 1000 ns molecular dynamic simulation on a model of the entire TSHR generated by merging the extracellular region of the receptor, obtained using artificial intelligence, with our recent homology model of the transmembrane domain, embedded it in a lipid membrane and solvated it with water and counterions. The simulations showed that the structure of the transmembrane and leucine-rich domains were remarkably constant while the linker region (LR), known more commonly as the 'hinge region,' showed significant flexibility, forming several transient secondary structural elements. Furthermore, the relative orientation of the leucine-rich domain with the rest of the receptor was also seen to be variable. These data suggest that this LR is an intrinsically disordered protein. Furthermore, preliminary data simulating the full TSHR model complexed with its ligand (TSH) showed that (a) there is a strong affinity between the LR and TSH ligand and (b) the association of the LR and the TSH ligand reduces the structural fluctuations in the LR. This full-length model illustrates the importance of the LR in responding to ligand binding and lays the foundation for studies of pathologic TSHR autoantibodies complexed with the TSHR to give further insight into their interaction with the flexible LR.
abstract_zh: 促甲状腺激素受体（TSHR）的受体，一种G蛋白偶联受体（GPCR），作为自身免疫性甲状腺功能亢进症（格雷夫斯病）中的主要抗原而备受关注，该病由刺激性TSHR抗体引起。迄今为止，TSHR胞外区域仅有一个结构域被结晶化。我们对整个TSHR模型进行了1000纳秒的分子动力学模拟，该模型通过将人工智能获得的受体胞外区域与我们近期构建的跨膜结构域同源模型合并而成，并嵌入脂质膜中，用水和抗衡离子溶剂化。模拟显示，跨膜结构域和富含亮氨酸结构域的结构保持高度稳定，而连接区（LR），通常称为“铰链区”，表现出显著的灵活性，形成多个瞬态二级结构元件。此外，富含亮氨酸结构域相对于受体其余部分的取向也观察到可变性。这些数据表明，该LR是一种内在无序蛋白。进一步地，模拟完整TSHR模型与其配体（TSH）复合物的初步数据显示：（a）LR与TSH配体之间存在强亲和力；（b）LR与TSH配体的结合减少了LR中的结构波动。这一全长模型阐明了LR在响应配体结合中的重要性，并为研究病理性TSHR自身抗体与TSHR复合物提供了基础，以进一步深入了解它们与柔性LR的相互作用。
